A rejected later candidate spends no Reaction, token or permission. This is a scoped deterministic tie-break for these three spell permissions, not a rewrite of all interrupt priority or any class-specific reroll. Snapshot the original modifiers, including any eligible Alignment Nexus benefit, when the original roll is created; replacement retains those modifiers even if later alignment/ward changes would alter a genuinely new event. Apply only the final original event's consequences once. No additional cast, attack, target rescan, payment, hit, Wound, death event or resource grant is generated by a replacement.

NEW DE4-PRESENTATION-06 — proposed narrow digital presentation policy for this conference; NOT an already accepted visibility grant. This policy grants only the following event-result presentations. It does not disclose hidden creatures, secret events, source/rank/DC/AC information, hidden modifier reasons, RNG seeds or future draws. An explicit source prohibition on disclosure takes precedence. Unlisted or unclassified events remain unavailable to these three Fate permissions until separately authored; absence of a secrecy tag is not a grant.

1. OVERT-ATTACK: for an actual ordinary Core attack whose generating creature, declared attack and target are already perceived/identified by the reacting creature through its real senses, give that creature's authorized controller the complete resolved original attack d20 set before hit/miss consequences. This is an explicit new result-presentation decision, not a new sensing ability. Display the faces and which original selection rule is being applied, not the hidden causes of advantage, the target's AC or hidden modifiers. A hidden attacker or an unperceived/unknown target does not qualify under this entry. An extra camera, spectator role, battle log or engine access is not perception. An AI controller receives only the corresponding authorized view, not the entire engine state.

2. OWN-REQUESTED-CHECK: an actually requested, nonsecret ordinary ability/skill/tool check presents its complete original d20 set privately to that actor's authorized controller. Automatic/secret sensing checks, protected inquiries and hidden contests are excluded. Another reacting character can use that player's legitimate display only when that reacting character independently satisfies its own actual source perception/range/LoE and resource predicates; this rule grants no character-to-character telepathy. In a multi-character player party, the player may control both actors; a multiplayer peer does not inherit another player's private grant.

3. BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE: once an actual reviewed Burning Hands cone is manifested and the shared 3d6 operation is generated, present the complete shared faces before damage consequences to the caster's controller and to controllers of reacting characters who actually perceive the caster and the manifested cone. This whitelist entry is specifically for the reviewed Burning Hands damage operation, not every damage pool. It reveals no target list, save result, resistance or hidden recipient. Per-recipient damage is still computed once from the one final shared total. A reaction holder must additionally pass its own actual Coin range/LoE/hand/custody predicates. A source-suppressed operation that creates no actual damage draw gives nothing to reroll.

4. CONFUSION-BEHAVIOR: for this pending Confusion procedure, show the actual finite d4 behavior, any genuinely generated d8 direction, and any genuinely generated uniform 1dN perceived-target selection privately to the affected body's authorized controller before that behavior executes. Do not expose candidates that this body cannot actually perceive. Other controllers receive no raw selection results under this entry. A player who also controls a reacting holder can use that legitimate result view only if the reacting holder independently perceives the true roll-generating body and passes Coin's other source requirements. The snapshotted set and candidate order are immutable; an empty set makes no draw. A private NPC-controller view is not disclosed to human players.

5. RESONANCE-WELL-RESERVE: show the actual initial 1d4 reserve-creation draw privately to the Well creator's authorized controller before the reserve is established. This preserves the existing timing boundary but authors its digital display; it does not expose any already-established or hidden reserve and does not permit a later reroll/refill. The reacting holder still needs Coin's real event perception/range/LoE/custody/Reaction.

For these entries only, record policyId, entryId, original event ID, the authorized controller set and the actual perception evidence at generation. Recheck the reacting source's own spatial/resource predicates at commitment. Already lawfully learned original faces are not erased by a later effect, but event knowledge alone never satisfies a currently missing character predicate. Present only information this whitelist actually grants, whether or not any observer possesses a Fate source; resource possession cannot become a detector. Total-only or hidden-result policies remain insufficient. Preserve the original RNG component IDs and reduction rule through replacement. No rejected declaration or paid-but-blocked alteration generates a replacement draw.

This is a minimum concrete policy, not a universal dice-visibility policy. In particular, unlisted enemy saving throws, trauma, secret checks, loot/world generation and private source operations remain unavailable. Future presentation entries require explicit source-specific authorship and separate review. Composition vectors that declare a visibility grant remain composition vectors; that declaration is not evidence that an unlisted live source supplies one.

NEW BURNING-HANDS EVENT-EXISTENCE COMPLETION FOR CONCURRENCE: For this source only, each actually manifested Burning Hands cone generates exactly one complete original shared3d6 operation at its ordinary damage-resolution checkpoint whether the eligible recipient set is empty, entirely hidden, or includes known recipients. It is the same cast operation, not an extra roll, attack or damage packet per recipient. A cast interrupted or prevented before manifestation generates none. A manifested empty cone deals no damage and triggers no hit/damage/Wound/kill/resource consequence, even though its finite original pool is available under BURNING-HANDS-DAMAGE. Thus the presence, number, values, availability and timing of the published pool do not encode whether hidden recipients exist. No target list, saves, defenses or damage outcome is added to this presentation. A paid Coin may alter that original empty-cone pool only through its ordinary actual predicates, with its normal consumed item/Reaction/guard and no refunded cost; it creates no recipient or successful damage event. This is explicit NEW per-source RNG-generation authorship, not a rule for other empty areas or unlisted spells.

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Rank-three Divination: initiative, remains and information
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
## Rank-three Divination: initiative, remains and information

The [exact review](../../../../docs/audit/2026-10-08/full-game/GPT_DIVINATION_RANK3_EXACT_REVIEW.md) approves all eight cards without functional repairs. [Review status](DIVINATION_RANK3_REVIEW_STATUS.json) records their bounded manuscript scope.

**Future Echo** records a willing allied participant order and, at the next numbered round boundary, permutes surviving participants only among their existing regular baseline slots. Finish current end-round events, restore any prior Echo permutation while retaining legitimate other initiative changes, then apply pending schedules in stable application order. Earlier applications claim their eligible participants, including a singleton; later schedules skip those participants. Enemy/unselected slots stay fixed. A pending schedule suppressed or unavailable at its one execution boundary expires without makeup. Its execution commits a fixed one-round assignment rather than a state that can be dispelled midround to duplicate or skip turns. The baseline returns at the following boundary before another Echo is applied. Each participant still receives exactly one actual regular turn and its ordinary start/end procedure. Existing virtual duration, periodic, falling and absolute clocks do not migrate or replay. Outside initiative the spell has no scheduling effect. This is a tabletop procedure; the broader scheduler adapter and full Time Loop remain unimplemented/disabled as previously recorded.

**Speak with Dead** retains both school placements. Cast through Cleric, Mirrorsage, Ranger, Shaman, Wizard or Paladin as Divination; through Crimson Agent, Druid or Thief as Necromancy, under the actual selected class access. A Divination-only protection therefore does not automatically block its Necromancy placement. The spell uses a retained memory echo associated with actual remains/death context, not a summoned soul or resurrection. Old fragments do not automatically acquire memories from a later resurrected life. Hidden identity eligibility resolves after paid casting; currently living identities are ineligible. Five separate Action/question exchanges follow the casting Action within its one-minute window. Actual return to life or loss of the qualifying physical anchor ends the interview.

Eyes of the Divine inspects readable appearance/form layers without reverting the body. Reveal Weakness affects the next actual save event, including an automatic-result save without overriding its result. Planar Window separates public ordinary vision from the caster's private native-presence detection. Faction Divination reads a genuine institutional objective, Alignment Revelation supplies public visible sigils after a failed CHA save, and Resonance Sight (Greater) identifies readable local effects and recorded proximate provenance without remote current-location omniscience. Wider runtime, source variants, secrecy, information completeness and human balance remain open.

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Records, clocks and precedence
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
## Records, clocks and precedence

Each application records its identity, exact source, owner character, target, selected mode/components, application order, recorded source DC, deadline/marker, concentration or attachment relationship, remaining uses, and applicable immunity/suppression. Display names never create conditions or prerequisites. An owner's mark cannot satisfy another owner's class hook. A corpse marker, map point, archived spell, intrinsic Oracle Curse and hard-denial history are distinct state types.

Explicit operative effect text controls over a less-specific summary duration field. Use preserved regular-turn markers for **next** turn and bare N-round durations as in the combat guide; an in-progress current turn is not the next turn. Unqualified next turn refers to the source; explicit its/target refers to the target. Bare hostile N rounds, including hostile marks, use N future target regular ends. Beneficial/self N rounds use source regular starts. Preserve virtual markers through initiative changes and absence. Out of initiative bare N rounds use application+6N seconds, retaining that deadline on entering initiative. Explicit source/concentration endings still apply.

**NEW current-turn bridge:** “end of that turn” or the supplied bare “end turn” effects end at the end of the actual turn containing the application event, including another creature's or an extra turn. With no current turn, use application+6 seconds. An application during end-turn resolution expires at that same end after resolving, rather than acquiring a fabricated next turn. This applies to Resonant Seed, Winter's Embrace, Frost Totem and Glue. It does not override an explicit next-turn endpoint.

The reference represents an expiry as an ordered `(seconds, phase)` marker, preserving exact rational seconds from the combat clock. Every turn-end deadline uses expiry phase 20: current actual turn, source/target next regular end, Nth future target regular end, and Balanced Elements' following target end. End-trigger application/resolution occurs at phase 10 and the next event slot at phase 30. The effect therefore remains during final end events and expires afterward at that same second. Turn-start and absolute elapsed deadlines use phase 0. Callers must choose an explicit typed deadline; bare numeric expiries are rejected. No fractional-second workaround or duplicate turn is created.

Repeat saves, ordinary duration expiry and previously reviewed periodic/recharge clocks use regular turns unless an explicit exception applies. This is **not** a global rule changing every “each turn” damage trigger. Zone entry/start application checks, repeat ending saves and once-per-numbered-round caps are distinct events. Follow each source's actual trigger and cap; concentration alone grants no recurring application save.

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Speed arbitration
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
## Speed arbitration

**NEW:** Keep soft flat reductions, soft fractional reductions, explicit Speed0 controls, and Core Grappled/Restrained separate. Terrain changes movement cost; it is not a Speed penalty. “Hostile soft control” means an adverse control record regardless of whether an enemy, ally or the victim applied it.

1. Determine each possessed mode's Speed after compatible ordinary bonuses and systemic flat penalties (including serum/expedition Strain, serum side effects, cargo and stances). Their existing stacking rules still apply.
2. Evaluate every unsuppressed adverse soft-control record against that **same** pre-control Speed. Flat -10 gives `max(0, Speed-10)`; half gives `floor(Speed/2)`; use the exact registered formula for other records.
3. Use the lowest result. Different slows do not add unless an expressly reviewed source grants an exception. Keep all losing records and their independent deadlines.
4. Apply separately established global multipliers such as Exhaustion's half-Speed. Apply an active Hypermutation floor as specified below.
5. An explicit Speed0 state, Core Grappled/Restrained, Exhaustion5 or another actual immobilization overrides the numeric result. An unavailable mode remains unavailable. A separate prohibition on voluntary movement is not removed by a positive Speed.

Thus -10 and half on Speed30 yield15; Exhaustion then yields7. Two -10 records yield20, not10. Serum/expedition penalties remain independent system penalties, not competing hostile slow records. A minimum attached to a penalty cannot raise existing Speed: Iron Leash Aura uses `min(preSpeed, max(5, preSpeed-10))`.

Active adverse soft controls and explicit source Speed0 controls carry `eligibility.slowed-foe`; Core Grappled/Restrained alone, Prone, cargo, terrain and Exhaustion do not. A numerically overshadowed application still qualifies. Suppressed, expired or prevented applications do not.

Same owner/target/group/exact profile refreshes without adding magnitude or shortening its remaining deadline. Different magnitude/formula profiles retain separate deadlines within a group; a weaker later application cannot erase an unexpired stronger one. Removing/suppressing one record exposes any other valid record. Paid reapplication and source caps remain required. No arithmetic Speed result grants movement: the combat guide's common spent-movement ledger still applies.

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Marks and one-use components
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
## Marks and one-use components

Marks retain owner, target type/cap, source clock, independent rider entitlements and eligibility tags. They are not automatically Core Marked or mutually interchangeable. Trigger wording matters: next attack spends on the qualifying attack roll; next hit spends on a qualifying hit even if damage becomes0; when damaged requires a positive resolved-damage packet after defenses but before temporaryHP. Only the component named by a consumption event ends, unless the source says the whole mark ends.

**Reviewed healing-conference clarification:** numeric actualDamageDealt is tempHP absorbed plus actual normalHP lost to the packet, excluding overkill and later recovery/state assignments. A positive packet against an HP1 floor can have numeric0: Divine Judgment still reflects its minimum1 and consumes that actual turn's entitlement. A fully prevented resolved0 packet does neither. The [healing guide](HEALING_DEATH_PLAYTEST.md) defines the complete distinction; this clarification adds2 checks to the previously reviewed148-case control scope.

Guiding Star's reference API begins the legal qualifying attack **before** rolling: consume the available+2 entitlement and return the bonus plus a unique attack token. After the roll, resolve that token once with the hit outcome to receive any remainingS radiant rider. A miss leaves that hit rider for a later ally attack. Duplicate or foreign token resolution is rejected. Suppressed/illegal attack starts spend nothing. If the mark expires or becomes suppressed before resolution, it grants no hit rider; beginning an attack never refunds its spent attack bonus.

| Source | Operational handling |
|---|---|
| Balanced Scales | Actual HP restored to living ally applies mark to source next regular start. First enemy positive damage triggers S+M radiant once, no retaliation recursion. Keep printed at-most-once/marked-ally/round even if healing refreshes. |
| Divine Judgment | First positive damage to another creature on each actual target turn, including extra turns, reflects half actual damage, floor, min1/maxCleric level. No off-turn trigger. Repeat ending WIS saves remain regular-end; concentration/max3 target rounds retained. |
| Carrion Conductor | Corpse-only timed marker. Separate used-corpse history survives expiry, burst or suppression; that corpse cannot be marked again by Carrion Conductor, regardless of owner. It does not ban unrelated corpse mechanics. |
| Drake Mark | One marked target, new replaces old, source next regular end. First subsequent direct polearm hit consumes; triggering leap, DoT or copies do not. AddsS in qualifying hit's damage resolution even if final damage becomes0. |
| Oracle Guiding Bolt | **NEW two entitlements:** first ally-other-than-owner attack gets+2 then spends that opportunity on hit/miss. Next qualifying ally hit before expiry addsS radiant and ends mark. A miss leaves the hit rider, without another+2. New paid application replaces/reset both, never stacks. |
| Oracle Wrathful Brand | Owner's next damaging attack hit adds half unmodified rolled base dice, floor/min1; requires positive pre-bonus resolved attack damage. Separate first ally-positive-damage entitlement attempts1d6 heal and one WIS save; failed save applies printed attack penalty. Heal prevention/full HP does not refund it. Spending riders does not itself end the timed Brand. |
| Oracle Constellation | Owner mark set, printed2 targets/3 mastery; recast replaces previous set. Its+1d6 cap is once/numbered round across set, not per target. |
| Oracle Omen Reader | Triggering -2 attack adjustment consumed once; subsequent star-ash+1 ally attack benefit persists through target-next-end. |
| Paladin Vengeance | Preserve Smite/Brand/Retribution IDs and owner-qualified eligibility. Retribution die consumption does not end its opportunity-attack advantage or remaining mark. |
| Paladin Linked Ward / Chain of Duty | Willing-ally concentration links with separate redirection/teleport triggers, not generic Marked. Ordinary Reaction and printed per-round limits apply. |
| Ranger Track Target | One quarry, new replaces old,1minute; does not reveal through total cover. Predator's Mark upgrades underlying quarry; ending its concentration leaves underlying quarry until its own endpoint. |
| Ranger Pathfinder's Mark | Fixed point,24h; navigation state, not creature condition. |
| Soldier Marked for Death | One target; saves penalty through source-next-start. First qualifying hit against another ally spends its -1 damage rider even if damage0; does not consume the persistent save penalty. No stacking with Intimidating Presence where printed. |
| Tinker Target Scanner | First qualifying ally attack gets+1 and consumes that scanner record on the roll, hit or miss; source-next-start deadline. |
| Wizard Binding Sigil | One target; only owner's Wizard spell attacks gain advantage; source-next-end. No companion/echo/environmental application. |
| Wizard Gravebrand | Source-qualified mark and necrotic periodic effect; the name/Pact does not classify it as an inflicted curse. |

**NEW Divine Judgment simultaneous-target order:** use printed source target order; otherwise declared target/list order fixed before damage, or stable area target application order established before resolving. First recipient taking positive damage supplies reflection magnitude; never sum victims. The turn entitlement is then spent.

Corpses, intrinsic class progression, Monk hard-denial history and Mirrorsage/Wizard archive-retention markers are bookkeeping rather than creature Marked. Existing Crimson Blood Mark, Oracle Mark of the Doomed, Paladin Grief and Warrior Vulnerable identities retain their reviewed rules.

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Curse and disease
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
## Curse and disease

`classification.curse` and `classification.disease` are metadata on actual inflicted affliction records, not new generic conditions or inherent penalties. This packet adds no disease-producing source and no generic inflicted curse source. Oracle intrinsic Curse/Burden/Boons/Manifestation, quest/pact unlocks, Blood Curse's name and Shaman hex-damage wording do not create those affliction categories. Plague Bearer/Infectious Mutation explicitly do not create diseases.

A repeat-save feature only repeats a currently legal saving throw that the actual affliction allows. It creates no new save, DC or cure. Ordinary curse removal respects explicit removability, special cures, protection and tier limits. Cleansing Brand's unknown non-spell curse tier is a dependency, not permission to invent a favorable tier.

**NEW disease-immunity bridge:** covered new disease applications are prevented; covered mechanical effects of existing diseases are suppressed while immunity lasts, with records and progression clocks retained. Nonmagical/ordinary/all-disease scopes are distinct. Suppression is not cure. Lethal/progressive diseases must individually specify whether immunity blocks progression, its endpoint, or just penalties; do not universally postpone death or resurrect through immunity. The disease catalog remains open.

Analyze Magic/Arcane Sight may reveal actual permitted magical curse/link metadata within their printed examination procedures. They do not overcome protected Oracle class information. Identify does not automatically reveal curses; Detect Magic/Aura Glimpse do not gain that extra information. Neither a display name nor the absence of metadata proves a successful cure/detection.

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Compulsion, action denial and initiative
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
## Compulsion, action denial and initiative

Keep Charmed/Frightened, one commanded Action, Reaction denial, Speed0/half and attack restrictions as distinct components. The shared source-character/target/encounter hard-denial guard controls new hard components across feature names. A used allowance blocks only a new hard component; apply an expressly printed soft fallback, otherwise do not invent one. Hard-control immunity and source restrictions still apply.

Oracle Bone Whisper, Ledger's Command, Marquis's Glimpse, Slumber Glimpse and Moment's Pause soft fallback records, and Paladin Decree/Echo of Ages soft fallbacks, carry slowed-foe eligibility only while their actual Speed component is active. Spiral Opens instead has a distinct player-Speed0 component; choosing a repeated action or using NPC Forced Echo does not gain that tag. Passive Stars Revelation Mastery is a HOOK authorizing a later enhanced Guiding Bolt component, not an immediate applied slow. The registry separates application, modifier and reader/bookkeeping references.

Ledger's Command may command one hostile Action under that guard; subsequent qualifying failures use its Reaction+Speed0 fallback. Bone Whisper, Marquis's Glimpse, Slumber Glimpse and Moment's Pause retain their own hard/fallback splits. Slumber's -2 initiative rider affects the next eligible initiative roll/check before encounter end, never an already-established slot. Its attack bonus is independently consumed.

Wizard Mental Binding/Arcane Domination and Paladin Decree of Submission retain only their printed first commanded turn; ongoing Charmed/Reaction/Speed riders cannot command another Action. Mind Prison's first Incapacitated/commanded replacement is separate from later half-Speed/no-Reaction riders. The player retains printed target/route choices and prohibitions on self-harm, beliefs, resource expenditure and permanent allegiance. An NPC Forced Echo from The Spiral Opens spends the hard-denial allowance and has no invented NPC fallback after it is used. Its player branch stays distinct. Royal Decree's target-chosen Prone-or-safe-movement retains Action/target choice and does not spend the whole-Action denial allowance.

Echo of Ages' attack denial uses the shared hard guard; later actual qualifying failed applications use its printed soft fallback. It does not gain a repeat trigger every round from concentration. Reign of Ashes is soft half-Speed/noDash/**no willing teleport benefit**, ending target-next-end. **NEW:** target cannot self-teleport or consent to another's transport; independently legal involuntary hostile displacement can still affect it unless that effect needs willingness. No Root/Restrained or universal planar anchoring is added.

**NEW Moment's Pause delay:** snapshot canonical initiative order excluding temporary delays. One pending delay per target per next numbered round; repeated applications do not stack. At next-round construction process stable application order. Find the first still-participating snapshot creature after the target, skipping removed/dead and ignoring new entrants absent from that snapshot; move target immediately after it. With no surviving later snapshot member leave current position. Chained delays are deterministic in application order; no participant is duplicated/deleted and no virtual duration/falling/recovery marker changes. The next following round resumes canonical order. This is distinct from modifying an initiative roll.

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Damage quantities and resolution
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
## Damage quantities and resolution

| Quantity | Definition and use |
|---|---|
| resolvedDamage | After defenses, before tempHP; positive damage event iff greater than0 |
| tempAbsorbed | min(tempHP, resolvedDamage) |
| postTempDamage | resolvedDamage minus tempAbsorbed, uncapped by currentHP; Core Instant Death/Wounds |
| actualHpDamage | NormalHP lost to the packet after true prevention; recovery and state-assignment loss excluded |
| actualDamageDealt | NEW anti-overkill bridge: tempAbsorbed plus actualHpDamage; numeric actual-damage drains/reflections |

Ordinary “damages,” “takes damage” and “damaging hit” predicates use a positive resolved packet. Actual-HP wording (Burning Blood/Rewind Wound) uses actualHpDamage. Numeric actual-damage wording (Sanguine Rite/Echo Leech/Merciful Smite/Wound Eater/Gravebrand) uses actualDamageDealt. Source attack/hit predicates remain distinct.

Example: HP10/temp10 takes5: numeric actual damage5, actualHP damage0, positive packet. HP1 under a floor takes5: numeric0 but positive packet. HP3 takes12: numeric3, raw post-temp12. HP0 takes1: numeric0, positive packet and normal death-failure consequences.

Divine Judgment consumes its once-this-actual-target-turn entitlement on a positive packet, then reflects min(Cleric level, max(1, floor(actualDamageDealt/2))). Thus HP1-floor/numeric0 reflects1 and consumes; fully prevented resolved0 does neither. Wrathful Brand/Balanced Scales use the positive predicate where their source says damage occurred.

Resolve a damage event in this order:

1. Snapshot pre-event HP/tempHP/Wounds; resolve defenses, temp absorption and uncapped post-temp damage.
2. Core Instant Death uses postTempDamage minus preHP greater than or equal to effective maximum when reduced to0. It precedes ordinary floors. Open a legal would-die replacement; stop that packet's death procedure. No Wound save or zero-HP failure follows this branch.
3. If not Instant Death, resolve applicable true floors. They cannot raise an already0 creature. They preserve raw damage and attached conditions; a prevented drop creates no drop-only Wound trigger, but half-max/Maiming still applies.
4. Spiral-TouchedIII alone has a specific pre-Wound recovery exception. If positive-to-zero remains, spend its use, preserve that raw crossing trigger, attempt quarter-max direct recovery and apply phase-out. Broad HP-gain prohibition blocks the recovery but not the use/phase.
5. Resolve the one Core Wound save using original post-temp damage and pre-event Wounds. Fatal Wound death opens its own legal replacement window. Actual death ends Spiral phase; a successful independent Ward prevents actual death.
6. Resolve already-zero damage failures/death and its legal replacement window. A successful replacement stops skipped same-packet death branches; never replay a Wound/failure branch merely because replacement changedHP.
7. Finalize a newly surviving0 creature's dying/Stable/knockout state. Only an explicitly triggered post-zero Reaction such as Grace Reversal can act before ordinary zeroHP Reaction loss finalizes.
8. Resolve eligible post-zero Phoenix/Unyielding-style healing only if target still lives, followed by later triggers. This healing never retroactively reduces the triggering packet's numeric damage.

The affected creature chooses among simultaneously eligible offered survival effects, then rechecks remaining triggers. A paid Reaction spends its declared cost; a limited automatic survival use spends when its actual source resolves. A true floor preventing the crossing means Spiral's use is not spent. No generic extra Reaction or return from death is created.

For Ritual Ward, sufficient body and no explicitly unpreventable death are prerequisites. It can intercept Instant Death, fatal Wounds, third death-save failure, eligible direct death and lethal tracks. Positive pre-eventHP→1 is loss prevention and works through Decay. Already0 with HP gain prohibited instead becomes living Stable0: clear counters and establish a d4-hour recovery deadline immediately.

Freeze packetHpLossBeforeReplacement after true floors but before Ward. Ward metrics are min(packetHpLossBeforeReplacement, max(0, preHP minus replacementHP)); never include loss caused solely by assigning a lowerHP state. HP20 takes10 then fatal Wound/Ward1 means actualHP damage10, not19. HP5 takes100 then Ward1 means actualHP damage4, raw100.

Direct death (e.g. Wound EaterIII) produces no damage or Wound save. Its healing requires actual death; a Ward interception prevents that trigger without refunding the paid activation. False LifeI has only its printed floor and failed-death-save replacement modes sharing1/LR; it is not an all-causes Ward.

currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
## ZeroHP permissions and start timing

A conscious but dying creature still rolls at each regular start unless Stable. Extra turns do not advance these regular-start deadlines. Further damage and actual death retain normal consequences.

Mage Undying Spellform partially overrides only zeroHP Unconscious/Incapacitated restrictions: normal speech, voluntary half-Speed movement, normal Action, legal spellcasting with that Action, and starting/maintaining concentration. No independent BA/Reaction. Existing concentration avoids automatic loss from zeroHP, but the triggering damage still requires its concentration save. Separate Stunned/Unconscious/Expedition5 or6/Silence and other restrictions still apply. Healing above0 ends the feature. Expiry at0 destabilizes, cancels the Stable recovery deadline and adds one failure; the third kills normally and permits only an eligible would-die replacement.

Oracle False LifeIII permits exactly one choice during the allowed zeroHP turn: move up to Speed, speak, or activate one Revelation. The latter uses its printed Action/BA/trigger (trigger must occur on that turn), costs and components. It can start concentration; the feature did not preserve earlier concentration. No independent actions accompany the choice.

False LifeV quarter-max direct recovery resolves at its next regular start before the death save. Blocked recovery leaves0 without invented stability; dead creatures do not revive. Spiral phase expires at its next regular start before normal start processing. Fate-BoundIV rerolls a failed death save before committing natural1/counters; use the new result. Its generic death-effect save bonus is not an ordinary death-save modifier. A natural20 whose1HP is blocked uses the previously reviewed Decay bridge: Stable0, cleared counters, immediate d4-hour deadline and preserved used-turn marker. It does not spend Ward. This differs from blocked False LifeV, which remains dying.

currentGoverningExcerpts.heading: Ordinary healing arithmetic
currentGoverningExcerpts.exactText:
## Ordinary healing arithmetic

Determine legal source, recipients, costs, clocks and available entitlements before arithmetic. The helper receives already eligible modifiers; it does not acquire class powers or validate every source for its caller.

Pre-resolution modifiers include Words of Equilibrium's formula M, Zealot's Fervor +S, Throne's Grace +1/die capped S+M, Benevolent Spirits' eligible paid-technique +M, Life Prophecy maximizing dice, and Crane's applicable +S. Conditional add-ons include Ground, Radiance, Aura of Faith, Ember Mantle, Life Linked's rolled1d4, Ranger Healing Touch, Aura of Mercy, Garden's stored+1 and Tranquil Lotus Step.

First compute without conditional add-ons. Only if this preview actually restores at least1HP, recompute that same event once with its eligible add-ons. The preview changes no pools/uses. Base5 minus5 plus a conditional3 remains0; eligible pre-resolution Benevolent3 yields3. Multiple flat class bonuses use the strongest across both passes unless an explicit source exception allows stacking. Rolled extra dice/per-die changes are separate.

Within each permitted reduction plan: formula/bonuses; per-die adjustments; compatible exact fractional multipliers with one floor after multiplication; compatible flat reductions; floor at0; broad HP prohibition; maximum/Critical/reserve caps. Intrinsic Wound Eater and systemic Corrupted remain independent factors. Duplicate same-stat per-die penalties use the strongest. Dice remain dice when maximized/shared; flat Lay on Hands and stored numeric Echoes have zero healing dice.

Blight Totem cannot compound other local healing reducers. Compare systemic factors plus Totem-half alone against systemic factors plus all otherwise compatible local reducers; use the lower result. Compatible halves multiply, compatible distinct flat penalties add, duplicate same-profile groups use strongest. Suppressed reducers do not participate.

Every present, operative, applicable next-positive-healing reduction consumes exactly once when the final event commits if its pre-reduction HP potential was positive. This includes reducers whose arithmetic branch lost to Totem or whose actual gain was later blocked. Zero potential and suppressed records consume none. Two-pass preview never consumes twice.

Critical at3Wounds caps ordinary healing at max(1, effective maximum minus1); it is not a maximumHP reduction and healing cannot lower currentHP. Reserve spends only actualHP restored. A final heal8 with room3 spends3 reserve; blocked healing spends0, other activation costs remain paid. Revival/form changes/encounter starts do not replenish reserve.

## Recovery gates, triggers and loops

False Life curse gates another creature's healing SPELL: optional Insight vs RevelationDC; success permits; failed or declined check rolls d2,1 blocks HP and2 permits. Nonspell recovery and independent nonHP components remain distinct. Burning Blood blocks the cold-tagged HP-healing component only, not independent tempHP/stabilization/resurrection.

Actual positiveHP restoration is required for Radiance's cure, Renewal's Stamina, Sanctified Reprisal and Life Prophecy's RC trigger. Meditative Healing's laterKi and Transcendent Meditation's second-pulseKi are independent components and still resolve when healing caps/blocks. Blood Tithe uses its actual qualifying hostile Bleed-death trigger and finite use; not staged farming.

Passive regeneration includes Bloodthick Node, Rapid Coagulation, Regenerative Mutation and Bio-Stabilizer's modification; these retain Reserve. Finite paid/limited pulses such as Aura of Grace, Living Pulse, Renewal Totem, Blood Feast, Exsanguinate, Hemostasis, Transcendent Meditation, Cellular Reconstruction and Adrenal Floodgate are not passive regeneration. Their own Downed/Incapacitated gates remain. A passive-regeneration prohibition is not a universal healing prohibition.

Lay on Hands retains its5×Paladin-level finite pool and ordinary Long Rest refill. Base Action spends at most level on one target; Hero1/LR spends the entire remaining pool across at most3, each allocation at least1. No RP conversion. Verdict Absolute's explicit qualifying brand-kill refill is a source exception. **Remainder-conference amendment — engine[13] cadence reconciliation:** level17 Wave is1/long rest, superseding the preserved Hero card and earlier guide's1/short-rest wording. This follows the explicit engine reconciliation; the old source remains intact. Wider pool/recharge execution still belongs to the resource pass.

Transfusion donor spends K normalHP; recipient ordinary base is K+floor(K/2). Channel Life spends X; baseX. Donor must remain at least1, tempHP cannot pay, loss is not damage and cannot be prevented/redirected/refunded when recipient gets0. Recipient legal bonuses/reductions apply.

Secondary healing retains root ID and visited application IDs in a shared causal ledger, including across sibling branches. Each link/application can fire at most once/root. Numeric add-ons remain the same packet, creating no new root/child. Legal finite primary healing may trigger unrelated eligible effects.

Stronger source flags override generic provenance: Vitality Link's child blocks every further link; Echo Leech blocks secondary healing/resource triggers; Blood Feast blocks damage/resource triggers; Merciful Smite blocks Smite/heal-copy chains; Crown Undying blocks redirection/heal-copy chains; Echoes/Spiral copies retain their explicit exclusions. Source payment and direct/actual-gain predicates still apply before a child exists.
